title: The best tour of Granada
text:
The best walking tour I have ever done and certainly an essential experience for anyone visiting Granada.

Thank you to Lucia and Fabiana for their incredible energy. They really make a difference: their warmth and closeness make the experience so much more special. I arrived as a tourist but within minutes they made me feel at home.

author: alexsago_1

title: Don’t let it pass. 100% worth it
text: At first I was a little skeptical about the idea of a tour without a guide. But the truth is I was surprised. We are a group of 4 and only 2 got a ticket to enter the Alhambra, so as an alternative a friend and I booked this tour and it is 100% worth it. He explains many things that no one explains to you. Unless you hire a guide, there's no way someone can give you all the information. We finished the tour in 4-5 hours, more or less the same as my friends took on their tour, and I think I learned more with the audio guide than on a tour. title: Good points but could be improved
text:
Rep at the office where we collected tickets was extremely helpful (Laura) she set up the audio and helped direct us to the start point. The actual site was not great with signage which was a little confusing. The audio cut out and had to both log in on a few occasions which wasn’t the best!
Beautiful place, well worth the visit but go early as gets really busy.
